reviewer.method: Entire official cloud text, all fresh PDF layout lines, both complete figures, clinical and author tables read. patient_identity.statement: F1-10 identity, sex and family relationship match the narrative/pedigree. Packet age 48 corresponds to the narrative or later six-year follow-up.
limitations: Source figure ages differ from narrative for F1-3 (76 vs74), F1-5 (73 vs71), F1-10 (49 vs48); F1-11 is 38 in figure/table decade but narrative says cognitive testing in her 40s. Exact last-encounter timing remains unclear.

genotype.statement: Source reports heterozygous NM_002291.3:c.5250_5253del/p.(Asn1750LysfsTer4), agreeing with the packet coding/protein expressions and allelic state.

evidence.locator: Sanger screening/confirmation for five F1 members

limitations: The article does not print the packet genomic coordinates or VCF representation; those were not independently remapped or re-called here.

segregation.statement: The same end-truncating variation is reported in three affected siblings and two affected daughters of F1-5, consistent with dominant familial transmission.
limitations: Open pedigree symbols mean healthy by family history with no MRI, not proven noncarriers or independently examined unaffected controls. Grandparental molecular origin is unknown.

phase.statement: A single heterozygous allele is reported in a dominant disease model; a two-allele cis/trans question is not applicable.
limitations: No second pathogenic allele is asserted by this packet.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors call the variant pathogenic and link this end-truncating class to the characteristic leukoencephalopathy/memory phenotype, supported by the previous report and this six-case series.
limitations: NMD escape is a predicted class mechanism in this paper, not directly measured in these subjects. The molecular appendix contains sequencing methods, not RNA/protein assays.

The paper supplies no newly calibrated variant-classification evidence or independent truth standard. F2-1 has a reported right-thalamic lacune despite the disease label and figure caption implying absence of lacunes.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Every packet feature compared with the subject narrative, neuropsychology table and shared imaging description. Symptomatic word-finding/numbness/imbalance is distinguished from an objectively diagnosed deficit, and exact onset ages are not inferred from decade ranges.
